# 3 bedroom detached house for sale

> ABOUT YOUR HOME Step into the Hazel and discover a welcoming entrance hallway, complete with a WC and handy storage space. At the heart of the home is a stylish open-plan kitchen and dining area, with French doors that open out to the garden - perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The layout flows seamlessly into a bright and spacious front-aspect living room, bathed in natural light.

- Dispozice: 3 bedrooms

- Cena: £375,000
